design_obligations.required_capability: Compare nested contact representations under matched data, compute, objective, safety, latency, and tuning budgets, separating prediction gain from impedance-action and held-out outcome gain.
design_obligations.why_current_methods_fail: The supplied integrated rich model and its three anchor papers each demonstrate a mechanism or controller, but none identifies component-wise decision value or a minimal sufficient representation.
design_obligations.measurable_acceptance_condition: For every retained component, leave-one-component-out removal changes rendered stiffness or damping beyond implementation resolution and changes at least one prespecified held-out endpoint beyond a sensor-grounded equivalence margin without material loss on the others.

design_obligations.required_capability: Represent only independently observable contact-area and local-geometry statistics, with a mechanically consistent finite-area forward model and calibrated online latency.
design_obligations.why_current_methods_fail: The supplied model infers patch extent from indentation and effective radius, while also mixing a distributed HC pressure law with a separately normalized split-Hertz pressure law; this does not isolate measured spatial information value.
design_obligations.measurable_acceptance_condition: Spatial statistics remain reproducible on held-out specimens or regions, predict residual future wrench or constraint outcomes after conditioning on simple variables, and improve action and outcome criteria when retained.

design_obligations.required_capability: Estimate an action-relevant slip or wrench-capacity margin from the minimum tangential force and moment statistics, while controlling friction and coupling-medium drift.
design_obligations.why_current_methods_fail: The supplied model mainly predicts tangential force from Coulomb friction and asymmetric normal pressure and treats one bending moment as optional, without proving that measured tangential wrench changes impedance before failure.
design_obligations.measurable_acceptance_condition: The retained tangential statistic changes impedance before slip, contact loss, or moment-limit events and reduces those events on held-out directional or friction shifts without degrading task quality.

design_obligations.required_capability: Use the lowest-dimensional observable history statistic that resolves temporal aliasing across dwell, reversal, speed change, repeated loading, and recovery.
design_obligations.why_current_methods_fail: Hunt-Crossley penetration and rate are memoryless once the instantaneous state is fixed; the supplied model therefore does not represent relaxation, creep, recovery, or hysteretic state despite the accepted history root cause.
design_obligations.measurable_acceptance_condition: A low-order state predicts held-out future wrench or area beyond instantaneous variables, remains identifiable and stable online, and earns inclusion only when its removal breaks action or outcome equivalence.

design_obligations.required_capability: Locate the boundary where feedback bandwidth, estimator delay, controller authority, constraint distance, and uncertainty margins absorb representation error or allow it to change a safe impedance decision.
design_obligations.why_current_methods_fail: A per-update energy-tank inequality for virtual stiffness does not by itself certify the full sampled-data robot-contact loop, and a learned critic can exploit model error unless feasibility and fallback are calibrated under shift.
design_obligations.measurable_acceptance_condition: Across prespecified bandwidth, delay, speed, and constraint-margin strata, the method either demonstrates action and outcome equivalence of the simple comparator or a repeatable richer-state benefit while satisfying measured safety envelopes and fallback timing.

design_obligations.required_capability: Evaluate transient wrench and constraint safety together with an independent scanning-quality endpoint that is not used to estimate the contact representation.
design_obligations.why_current_methods_fail: The supplied control cost contains force, motion, and tangential penalties but no leakage-resistant independent ultrasound-quality endpoint, so improved internal cost cannot establish task benefit.
design_obligations.measurable_acceptance_condition: Held-out trials report confidence intervals for force or wrench safety, contact stability, trajectory or speed, and prespecified image or reconstruction quality, with no endpoint used as a representation input.

dominant_solution: A preregistered nested representation ladder, all coupled to the same impedance-action parameterization and objective, estimates the smallest representation whose removal breaks both action equivalence and held-out outcome equivalence. Levels are R0 synchronized six-axis wrench, pose/rate and speed; R1 adds independently calibrated contact area; R2 adds local normal/curvature separately from area; R3 adds measured tangential force and moment capacity margins; R4 adds the lowest identifiable standard-linear-solid or generalized-Maxwell history state; only predeclared interactions are added. Cross-fitting freezes every estimator and selector before held-out trials. The primary result is a component-by-operating-regime decision-value boundary, including the valid negative result that R0 remains sufficient.

supporting_mechanisms.mechanism_match: A separate bounded nominal model, disturbance tube or invariant feasibility set, solver-deadline monitor, and verified passive or low-energy fallback prevent the richer learned selector from defining its own safety envelope.
supporting_mechanisms.activation_condition: Active for every online policy and every representation level; if uncertainty coverage, estimator freshness, feasibility, or deadline checks fail, the selector is bypassed.
supporting_mechanisms.integration_interface: The selector proposes stiffness, damping and bounded reference increments; the shield accepts, clips, or replaces them using the same measured wrench, actuator and contact-loss or slip constraints across all representation levels.
supporting_mechanisms.removal_failure_prediction: Without the shield, an apparently better rich representation can exploit model error or delay, and the experiment cannot distinguish representation value from unsafe controller authority.

falsifiable_hypothesis: At least one added component earns inclusion only in predeclared regimes where its removal changes rendered impedance beyond implementation resolution and degrades a held-out safety or independent imaging endpoint beyond its equivalence margin; outside those regimes R0 is decision-equivalent.
candidate_treatment: Retain the candidate's finite-area, tangential and adaptive-impedance ideas only as testable feature families. Replace its mixed Hunt-Crossley plus split-Hertz pressure construction with measured low-dimensional statistics; replace the internal Q critic as the dominant claim with a controller-family-matched selector; and treat an energy tank as one monitored interface condition, not a full-loop certificate.

comparators: R0 model-agnostic six-axis admittance or impedance
each adjacent nested representation and every leave-one-component-out model
primary_endpoints: rendered stiffness and damping action equivalence
contact loss, slip and moment-limit events
prespecified ultrasound image or reconstruction quality not used by the estimator
experimental_design.analysis: Randomized repeated measures with specimen-level holdout, cluster-aware confidence intervals, predeclared equivalence margins, matched data/compute/objective/safety/latency budgets, and cross-fitted frozen estimators.

novelty_posture: Innovation is the falsifiable minimal-sufficiency and closed-loop decision-equivalence map, not any individual sensor, viscoelastic model, MPC, critic, or impedance component.
selection_tradeoff: Best fit to the certified Problem and Root Cause and the recommended route; experimentally broad but avoids betting the scientific claim on one uncertain constitutive model.

route_name: Mechanically coherent finite-area viscoelastic robust MPC
dominant_solution: Use one coherent reduced finite-area contact model rather than multiplying incompatible aggregate and pressure-field laws. Independently measured area and local geometry parameterize a finite-area normal-pressure surrogate; a lowest-order identifiable standard-linear-solid or generalized-Maxwell state captures relaxation and recovery; directly measured tangential force and bending or torsional moments define a calibrated frictional wrench-capacity margin. A robust tube MPC selects bounded impedance actions under explicit wrench, actuator, penetration, contact-loss and slip constraints, with a frozen simple model and invariant fallback. Ultrasound image quality remains evaluation-only.

supporting_mechanisms.mechanism_match: A matched adjacent-level and leave-one-component-out audit separates mechanistic prediction fit from actual impedance-action and held-out outcome value.
supporting_mechanisms.activation_condition: Mandatory before any area, geometry, tangential, history, or interaction term is retained in the deployed reduced model.
supporting_mechanisms.integration_interface: Each ablation uses the same robust MPC structure, action set, objectives, data, compute, safety margins, tuning budget and fallback; only the declared representation component changes.
supporting_mechanisms.removal_failure_prediction: Without this audit the route can show good fit or nominal tracking yet cannot answer the accepted minimal-sufficiency Problem and may retain unnecessary sensors or states.

falsifiable_hypothesis: A compact physically coherent area-geometry-wrench-history state predicts constraint approach early enough for robust MPC to change impedance and improve held-out safety or imaging outcomes; any component that fails the matched removal test is deleted.
candidate_treatment: Repair the candidate geometry identity so a pressure-support relation is internally consistent; do not combine aggregate Hunt-Crossley force with an independently normalized split-Hertz field; define material-derivative frame and sign; avoid double-counting pressure asymmetry with empirical front/rear radii; distinguish pressure-centroid bending moment from torsional friction capacity; include every predicted channel in identification; and replace memoryless penetration-rate damping with an identifiable relaxation state.

comparators: adjacent ablations of area, geometry, tangential margin and history
experimental_design.validation: Parameter calibration uses separate specimens or regions; terminal set, uncertainty set, deadlines and fallback are verified before held-out closed-loop trials; ex-vivo confirmation is bounded and follows benchtop falsification.
primary_endpoints: constraint and slip or contact-loss events

novelty_posture: The contact laws, viscoelastic states and robust MPC are prior art; novelty can only reside in the repaired integrated mechanism plus its matched minimality boundary, if confirmed.
selection_tradeoff: Highest mechanistic interpretability and closest to the user's candidate, but also highest identification, sensor, model-mismatch and real-time feasibility risk.

dominant_solution: Deploy a deliberately simple, frozen six-axis measured-wrench admittance or passive impedance controller, optionally expressed in independently sensed local surface coordinates and using negative desired signed distance only inside its unique-proxy region. No area, tangential-capacity or history estimate may influence the policy. Sweep bandwidth, delay, speed and distance-to-constraint while shadow estimators observe richer state, thereby locating where closed-loop feedback absorbs representation error and where the simple policy ceases to be action- and outcome-equivalent. Independent ultrasound quality is measured only after control decisions.

supporting_mechanisms.mechanism_match: Independently calibrated area, geometry, tangential-wrench and low-order history estimators run in shadow mode, enabling observability and counterfactual action-value tests without contaminating the simple controller.
supporting_mechanisms.activation_condition: Always active for data collection; a richer component may influence control only in a later preregistered crossover stratum after it passes observability, reproducibility and prospective threshold tests.
supporting_mechanisms.integration_interface: Shadow states are time-stamped against the simple controller's proposed and rendered actions, constraint margins and independent outcomes; an offline matched selector estimates counterfactual actions under the same resource and shield budgets.
supporting_mechanisms.removal_failure_prediction: Without shadow measurements the study could report simple-controller success but could not determine whether richness was unnecessary or merely unobserved, and it would not close the spatial, tangential or history root causes.

falsifiable_hypothesis: Within a bounded bandwidth-delay-speed-constraint region, a simple measured-wrench controller is decision-equivalent to every richer representation; outside that region one or more shadow components prospectively predict a reproducible action and outcome divergence.
candidate_treatment: Use the user's candidate primarily to define challenger features and adverse regimes, not the deployed dominant controller. The Q critic, hybrid pressure field and adaptive stiffness logic are omitted from the initial policy so the experiment can directly falsify their necessity.

comparators: preregistered richer-policy crossover only after shadow evidence
primary_endpoints: equivalence of proposed and rendered actions
experimental_design.boundary_map: Estimate the largest region in bandwidth, delay, speed, friction, relaxation and constraint distance for which the simple policy remains inside all predeclared action and outcome margins.

novelty_posture: A negative or bounded-sufficiency result is scientifically valuable and directly answers the contract; no novelty is claimed for the simple controller itself.
selection_tradeoff: Lowest implementation and safety risk and strongest disconfirming route, but it may require a second-stage crossover to demonstrate the positive value of richer state near failure boundaries.
